desc: Color Helix: Spin It drops you into a world of color and speed. Your ball rolls automatically along a rotating cylinder streaked with obstacles of different colors — your job is to turn the cylinder so the ball always passes through the section that matches its own color. The catch: the ball can change color mid-level, forcing instant decisions. Every stage layers on increasingly complex combinations, testing your reactions and your nerve all the way down.

faqs.question: What is Color Helix: Spin It?
faqs.answer: Color Helix: Spin It is a free arcade game where you rotate a cylinder so an automatically rolling ball passes through obstacles of its matching color, with the ball changing color mid-level to raise the challenge.

faqs.question: How do you control the ball in Color Helix: Spin It?
faqs.answer: You never control the ball directly — it rolls on its own. You rotate the cylinder left or right so the matching-colored sections line up with the ball's path.

faqs.question: Does Color Helix: Spin It get harder?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each new stage adds faster color changes and more complex obstacle combinations that demand quicker reactions and decisions.
